surveyed_upstream_ecosystems.name: rustdesk-server (hbbs / hbbr)
surveyed_upstream_ecosystems.rationale: 100% protocol-compatible rendezvous (hbbs) and relay (hbbr) server matching libs/hbb_common. Configured via Docker Compose / systemd self-host deployment configs without modifying protocol encryption.

surveyed_upstream_ecosystems.name: RustDeskIddDriver
surveyed_upstream_ecosystems.rationale: Official Indirect Display Driver (IDD) already integrated with libs/virtual_display and src/virtual_display_manager.rs in upstream RustDesk. Supports Windows 10 1903+ and Windows 11 Pro with RTX 3060 GPU acceleration. Driver installation remains opt-in requiring explicit Boss administrator approval.

surveyed_upstream_ecosystems.name: Virtual-Display-Driver (MttVDD)
surveyed_upstream_ecosystems.rationale: Evaluated as secondary high-refresh HDR/4K IDD fallback if custom EDID profiles are needed; not bundled simultaneously to avoid duplicate kernel/UMDF driver conflict. HDMI Dummy Plug documented as hardware last-resort fallback.

surveyed_upstream_ecosystems.name: sysinfo (rustdesk-org fork of GuillaumeGomez/sysinfo)
surveyed_upstream_ecosystems.rationale: Already locked in Cargo.lock and re-exported via hbb_common::sysinfo, avoiding duplicate dependency introduction while providing cross-platform CPU, RAM, Disk, Network, and AI process telemetry.

surveyed_upstream_ecosystems.name: LibreHardwareMonitor
surveyed_upstream_ecosystems.rationale: Primary GPU telemetry (RTX 3060 temp, VRAM, power, utilization) uses NVIDIA NVML / nvidia-smi and Windows PDH without third-party ring0 kernel drivers. LibreHardwareMonitor v0.9.6 is supported via read-only local HTTP JSON / WMI sensor bridge when user-started, adhering strictly to Section 22 rule against installing untrusted sensor drivers.

surveyed_upstream_ecosystems.name: Flutter
surveyed_upstream_ecosystems.rationale: Official modern UI layer for RustDesk Desktop & Mobile, extended with the DAUVERSE Executive SaaS design system, 16 screens, Floating Toolbar, Mini Control, AI Live Status, and Notification Center.
